# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Farrell Auctioneers, Valuers & Estate Agents are delighted to bring to the market this pretty bungalow excellently located within walking distance to Kinvara village. The dwelling itself was built in c. 1973 and extends to approx. 1,200 sq ft and is an E energy rating.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 111 m²
- Energetická náročnost: E
- Lokalita: Cartron, Kinvara
- Cena: 495 000 €
